newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond trade ideas - Eurodollar and Brady moves.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond trade ideas - Eurodollar and Brady moves.

text.p: Eurobond analysts' latest trade recommendations focused on lira, dollars and, in the emerging market sector, swaps between Eurodollar and Brady bonds for significant yield pick-ups.
Following are latest trade ideas, compiled by Reuters:
STRATEGY The spread has widened from 4 basis points at the beginning of the year to 13 b.p. over and offers good value.
STRATEGY In the last three months EIB has become expensive against the swap and BTP whilst Eurofima has cheapened.

STRATEGY The IBRD 10.75 percent bond has underperformed the IBRD 9.45 percent bond by 85 b.p. in price terms over the last month. This switch gives around an 11 b.p. pick-up in yield and a much cheaper bond.
STRATEGY This switch gives a pick-up in yield in the area of 6 b.p. and a 28 b.p. pick-up against the swap curve.
HSBC Markets recommends both Brady and Eurobond switches:
STRATEGY There is a steep Argentina curve offering large pick-ups for just two- and three-year extra maturities.

On the sell side the 8.375 pct bond is currently trading at 213 b.p. over Treasuries. On the buy side the Argentina Eurobond is trading at 336 b.p. over and the Brady bond is trading at 380 b.p. over.

STRATEGY The move into Brady's and out of Eurobonds gives a yield pick-up of around 62 b.p. This represents a larger than normal spread differental between the maturities 2002 and 2006, for bonds just over investment grade.
STRATEGY There is nearly a year's difference in maturity and the IDU amortising structure gives it a shorter average life than the Brazil Eurobond. This switch gives a yield pick-up of 25 b.p.
